author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
It takes longer for me to boot up my laptop, login the company VPN, than the actual work of nagging my AI agents to keep working harder. 

Teams won't work.  The Codex/Claude/Cursor/Copilot mobile app are in the wrong shape, not user friendly.

Someone should build a new hardware device that is tailor made for humans nagging their AI agents.  Something like the tablet in Star Trek.

author.name: Santosh Ahuja

comments.text: Don't use a computer. Call and talk to your agents on phone - completely secure and ask them to sms back secure links of demo's of work done.

author.name: Santosh Ahuja
author.headline: Engineering Executive | AI Infrastructure · GPU/Accelerator Systems · Distributed Systems · Silicon & Hardware-to-Cloud

replies.text: Horace Chan You will need twilio. You can configure a number - call in -> twilio intercepts the call and then transcribes the message and invokes an API that sends the prompt to your agent. Agent exceute -> can also converse back through the same route OR sms the demo link - some plumbing but possible.
